purpose: Teach: キャサリン/永田町/シェリー/ビクター/ディーン/クラッチ/ハンス/マルタ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、キャサリン妃の伝記を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer you mentioned — the one reading Catherine, Princess of Wales's biography — such a fascinating person.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Gentle delivery, like discovering something about someone you already like. Slight pause before the thought lands.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、永田町で議員秘書をされてたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She used to work as a parliamentary aide in Nagatacho, apparently. That would explain the thoughtfulness.
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning. Not gossiping — genuinely impressed by the reveal. Tone warm, conversational, like piecing together a puzzle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シェリー酒のソムリエ資格をお持ちだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she's actually qualified as a sherry sommelier. I mean, she clearly has real depth.
lines.style: Admiration with a note of wonder. Light emphasis on 'actually' — caught off guard by the discovery. Lingering on the detail with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ビクターレコードのコレクターだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Plus she collects Victor Records. You know, the old label. She's been collecting for years, I think.
lines.style: Slower pace now, almost reverential. Speaking like someone sharing something precious they've learned. Slight warmth creeping into the tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジェームス・ディーンの映画ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's a real James Dean fan too. Classic films, classic everything about her taste, really.
lines.style: Tender observation. Voice gentle and sure. Like confirming what you already sensed about someone. No surprise in it — recognition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、車のクラッチ修理ご自身でされるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And — get this — she actually fixes her own car clutches. She's that kind of person.
lines.style: Soft laugh of genuine delight underlying the words. A note of 'how is she real?' without saying it. Affection clear in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハンス・ベイサーの絵がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She collects Hans Beyaert paintings too, apparently. It's all so perfectly, quietly elegant.
lines.style: Voice settling into a kind of awed admiration. Speaking slowly, almost to herself. The kind of tone you use when you've realized someone is rare.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マルタ騎士団の歴史を研究されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she researches the history of the Knights of Malta. I mean — who is this woman?
lines.style: Trailing off with gentle awe. Soft, almost rhetorical finish. The question itself is an expression of wonder, not real confusion. Warmth throughout.
